newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Merger advisory committee meets on Boeing.
newsitem.headline: Merger advisory committee meets on Boeing.

text.p: EU national antitrust experts will meet later on Friday 1500/1300GMT to discuss the $16 billion merger between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp, a Commission spokesman told a news briefing.
On Wednesday the European Commission gave preliminary approval to the merger and Europen Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said he expected the committee to confirm this.
But Prime Minister Lionel Jospin warned earlier today he wants to know the exact impact of the last-minute commitments given by Boeing to secure EU regulatory blessing for the deal.
The committee has only an advisory role.

European Research Commissioner Edith Cresson also said on Thursday the merger with McDonnell Douglas was out of line with competition law and would give the merged group a near or total monopoly in some markets.
Cresson was quoted by afternoon paper Le Monde as saying in an interview that the concessions were not negligible.

But, she said, "Beyond the position it will have in large capacity planes, Boeing is acquiring a monopoly in 100-seater craft and a virtual monopoly, 90 percent of the world market, in freight transport planes."
